The live file is gitignored on purpose: it is a list of OTHER PEOPLE'S
accounts, and a public repo has no business redistributing one.
Tracked players whose RANKED replays feed the analysis corpus.
Identity is the Riot ID, never a PUUID: a stored PUUID is encrypted per
API key, so it is resolved fresh on every run.
One entry per ACCOUNT, not per champion or per match. /replays is keyed on
PUUID and serves only that account's 5 most recent RETAINED files, so a
specific match is obtainable only while it sits in that window - coverage
comes from the pull cadence, never from a backfill.
role is the role the operator is studying this account for.
